reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Formula/specification review only; no empirical assumption, originality, GPU interface or efficacy verified.

formal_object.rationale: Shape-regular source patches j with area A_j; bounded second derivative kappa_j of the frozen decoder field; n_j interpolation controls with total N. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: C05: Linear interpolation of a twice-differentiable field -> Local O(kappa h^2) error bound; condition: Known derivative bound and shape-regular cells; A01: Cell area and control density -> h_j^2 proportional to A_j/n_j; condition: Two-dimensional surface cells of comparable aspect ratio; D01: Minimize sum a_j/n_j^2 at fixed sum n_j=N -> n_j proportional to A_j kappa_j^(2/3); condition: Positive bounds and continuous allocation; rounding separately All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: On shape-regular 2D patches, the squared interpolation bound scales as kappa^2 A^3/n^2. Convex interior KKT gives n proportional to A kappa^(2/3); equal marginal derivatives and total allocation are checked. Positive coefficients are required, and zero curvature, integer rounding, coverage and probe cost need separate constrained treatment.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: Decoder curvature bounds are not supplied by the model; finite differences are estimates. The stated interior allocation uses strictly positive A and kappa; zero-curvature patches and coverage floors require a separate constrained allocation.; Shape regularity and coverage must be verified on the actual anchor mesh.; Sparse interpolation can miss thin parts and correct detailed motion.; Evaluation still emits and scores the full original mesh and times. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Allocate a fixed query budget using area and declared curvature estimates, then reconstruct the dense field with a qualified interpolant. The reviewed construction is Continuous curvature/error budget allocation for decoder interpolation.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: At matched full query/probe budget, interpolation error should follow local curvature and area, not vertex count alone. It can be rejected by: Reject new-method investment if historical m07/curvature-aware FPS already implements the same allocation or if uniform/geodesic FPS has the same native cost-quality frontier. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: Classical adaptive finite-element sampling; historical m07 query allocation and STAC curvature-boosted landmarks. Claimed operational difference: A derived allocation exponent and error model; strong functional collision risk makes this reserve, not a claimed new contribution. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
